literal_meaning: অকালের (অসময়ের) তাল (তাল গাছের কাঠ বা ফল)
figurative_meaning_en: Something obtained at an untimely or unexpected moment
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অকালের তাল পেয়ে হঠাৎ ধনী হয়ে গেল।
এই অকালের তাল তার জীবন বদলে দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He became rich overnight with an untimely windfall.
This untimely gain changed his life completely.
history: The idiom draws from Bengali agrarian traditions where harvesting or cutting palm trees (তাল) out of season was seen as inauspicious or yielding poor quality, symbolizing gains that come too soon or suspiciously.
note: Often carries a connotation of ill-gotten or fleeting wealth in cultural usage.
